no significant uncertainty as to measurability or collectability exists
then: royalties are recognised ON AN ACCRUAL BASIS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE TERMS OF THE RELEVANT AGREEMENT
note: One override exists and it is substance-based, not preference-based: where, having regard to the substance of the transactions, it is more appropriate to recognise revenue on some other systematic and rational basis, that basis is used instead. 'Systematic and rational' is the standard's wording and is not further defined in it — the alternative basis must be stated and justified, never assumed.
